column1: # What each fixture cannot reach of a real file, and what it runs that the file never does: the dispatch classes a header
# decides (crates/model/src/arch/coverage/reach.rs, the one reader: `parse_table`, by column name), each fixture planned from
# its source's header and compared with a real file's header. A (fixture, real) pair with no row is reached whole. Held by
# crates/model/tests/kcover.rs (the `tests/` reals: header tables checked in beside it) and by `fixture reach --check` (the
# `census/` reals: the stubs of tools/census/stubs.tsv, where the stub root is).
#   real     `tests/<stem>`: crates/model/tests/<stem>_hdr.kv.json and <stem>_tensors.tsv; `census/<org>/<repo>/<set>`: a stub set
#   side     `real`: the file holds the class and the fixture does not, so the fixture tier never runs it; `fixture`: the
#            fixture holds it and the file does not, so the fixture tier runs an entry the file never does
#   kind     `need` (a models::Need, by its text), `pin` (a tensor stem and its stored type), `width` (a matrix stem and its
#            first two dims), `router` (models::shape::select_router's instance for a mixture, or its refusal)
#   reason   `cut`: the fixture's source agrees with the file, the cut (its layer map, its mini widths and counts) does not;
#            `ff`: the cut's narrowed routed ff alone (a plan at the source's ff agrees); `source`: the fixture's source
#            disagrees with the file (another quant mix or shape of the family). A type pin a fixture-variants row retypes
#            the fixture to is reached by that variant and is no row.
